form.label: Import health
form.description: Processing completion and indexing completion are distinct. New imports become ready only after every dataset matches its manifest.

search.query: index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=* | stats count BY member_id | eval member_label=if(member_id="personal","Personal",member_id) | fields member_id member_label

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:worker earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=$member|s$ | sort - _time | head 1 | eval seconds_since_heartbeat=round(now()-_time) | table _time status inbox_path seconds_since_heartbeat reason

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:import earliest=0 latest=+10y | search member_id=$member|s$ status!=watching | sort - _time | head 50 | table _time status archive_name export_id expected_records reason

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:* earliest=0 latest=+10y | where event_kind="record" OR event_kind="manifest" | search member_id=$member|s$ | stats dc(eval(if(event_kind="record",event_id,null()))) AS indexed_unique max(expected_records) AS expected max(quarantined_rows) AS quarantined max(excluded_rows) AS excluded max(duplicate_rows) AS source_duplicates max(date_issues) AS date_issues BY export_id dataset | fillnull value=0 indexed_unique | eval outcome=if(isnull(expected),"manifest pending",if(indexed_unique=expected,"matched","indexing")) | table export_id dataset expected indexed_unique outcome quarantined excluded source_duplicates date_issues

index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:manifest earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=manifest member_id=$member|s$ | dedup export_id | search NOT [ search index=linkedin sourcetype=linkedin:ready earliest=0 latest=+10y | search event_kind=ready member_id=$member|s$ | fields export_id ] | eval seconds_waiting=round(now()-import_epoch), status=if(seconds_waiting>600,"indexing delayed — check permissions and saved search","indexing") | table snapshot_time export_id seconds_waiting status
